# ClaudeCLIBridge (RootHide)

Make Claude Code CLI actually work on a RootHide device — and use it with your official account, your own API key, or both at the same time.

## Install order matters

1. Add the Claude Code repository: `https://imcynic.github.io/claude-code-ios/`
2. Install **Claude Code** first
3. Then install **ClaudeCLIBridge**

**The convert screen is normal.** On RootHide, Sileo routes packages through RootHide Patcher before installing. If the package won't queue, or you see a *dependency not satisfied* message, that is the convert step — not a real dependency error. Convert, return to Sileo, and the queue resolves itself. Convert is safe here: both binaries keep all 9 entitlement keys and `bash-ios7`'s hash does not change.

## What it fixes

On rootless jailbreaks Claude Code already works. On **RootHide** it doesn't: the bootstrap lives in a randomly named directory, which creates two separate namespaces, and Claude Code ends up on the wrong side of them.

- `No suitable shell found` from the Bash tool
- Read / Write / Edit / Search failing to resolve paths
- OAuth login never opening Safari

This package's first job is to give Claude Code its full tool access back.

## Features

- Full tool access restored on RootHide — Bash, Read, Write, Edit, Search
- OAuth login working end to end, Safari handoff included
- Provider profiles: add an Anthropic-compatible API, set a default, switch between them
- Separate session pools per door, so `--continue` never mixes conversations
- Tokens stored in separate files with 0600 permissions — never inside the package, never in logs
- Eight-item self test (`claude-rh-doctor`)

## Requirements

- RootHide jailbreak, arm64e
- `com.anthropic.claude-code` installed
- zsh, ldid (already in the bootstrap)

Tested on iPhone, iOS 17.0.3, RootHide.

### Official Claude account (OAuth)
```
claude-rh --original
```
Type `/login` inside, pick your account, Safari opens. After tapping **Authorize** the button may keep spinning — it isn't stuck. Don't wait in Safari, switch back to the terminal; "Login successful" appears within a few seconds.

### Alternative API — no subscription needed
```
claude-provider add kimi
claude-provider use kimi
claude-rh
```
Use the provider's **Anthropic-compatible** root address, not the OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Claude Code appends `/v1/messages` itself:
```
CORRECT : https://api.moonshot.ai/anthropic
WRONG   : https://api.moonshot.ai/v1/chat/completions
```

### Session pools
```
echo on > ~/.claude-bridge/state/sessions
```
Off by default. Once on, `--original` and every provider profile keep their own history, even in the same working directory.

### Self test
```
claude-rh-doctor
```

The command is `claude-rh`. The `claude` and `claude-auth` commands on your system belong to a different package and do not use this bridge.

- Sileo depiction and repository listing
- No runtime changes

- Package description points at the repository
- No code changes

- Separate session pool per mode — two doors no longer mix in one directory
- Verified through RootHide Patcher: 9 entitlements kept, bash-ios7 hash unchanged
- Full clean-install test, API-only flow verified without a subscription

- Warns when the mode changes in a directory instead of failing silently
- browser-open rebuilt: diagnostics log is now optional and no longer fatal
- browser-open resolves its own path, independent of the working directory

- Depends on com.anthropic.claude-code, measured rather than assumed
- First from-scratch install test — four bugs found and fixed
- Base URL warning for OpenAI-style endpoints
- First package: launcher, doctor, claude-provider, PATH symlinks
